an4.183:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
an4.183:1.2: Atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi . . .
an4.183:1.3: pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca : Ahaṃ
an4.183:2.3: evaṃ me diṭṭhan ti n' atthi tato doso,
an4.183:2.5: evaṃ me sutan ti n' atthi tato doso,
an4.183:2.7: evaṃ me mutam ti n' atthi tato doso,
an4.183:2.9: evaṃ me viññātan ti n' atthi tato doso ti. 2.
an4.183:3.1: Nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ bhāsitabban ti vadāmi,
an4.183:3.2: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na bhāsitabban ti vadāmi.
an4.183:3.3: Nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ sutaṃ bhāsitabban ti vadāmi,
an4.183:3.4: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ sutaṃ na bhāsitabban ti vadāmi.
an4.183:3.5: Nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ mutaṃ bhāsitabban ti vadāmi,
an4.183:3.6: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ mutaṃ na bhāsitabban ti vadāmi.
an4.183:3.7: Nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ viññātaṃ bhāsitabban ti vadāmi
an4.183:3.8: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ viññātaṃ bhāsitabban ti vadāmi. 3.
an4.183:4.1: Yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa diṭṭhaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na bhāsitabban ti vadāmi.
an4.183:4.2: Yañ ca khvassa brāhmaṇa diṭṭhaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ bhāsitabban ti vadāmi.
an4.183:5.1: Yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa sutaṃ bhāsato . . . vadāmi.
an4.183:7.1: brāhmaṇa viññātaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti evarūpaṃ viññātaṃ na bhāsitabban ti vadāmi,
an4.183:7.2: yañ ca khvassa brāhmaṇa viññātaṃ bhāsato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti evarūpaṃ viññātaṃ bhāsitabban ti vadāmi.
an4.183:8.1: Atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā pakkāmīti. 184. 1.
